basic.name: Direct Punch
basic.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Luka's ATK to one designated enemy.

variants.name: Sky-Shatter Fist
variants.description_template: Consumes 2 stacks of "Fighting Will." First, uses "Direct Punch" to deal 3 hits, with each hit dealing Physical DMG equal to {{dp}}% of Luka's ATK to one designated enemy target. Then, uses "Rising Uppercut" to deal 1 hit, dealing Physical DMG equal to {{ru}}% of Luka's ATK to the designated enemy target.

skill.name: Lacerating Fist
skill.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{skill_dmg}}% of Luka's ATK to one designated enemy target. In addition, there is a 100% base chance to inflict Bleed on them, lasting for 3 turn(s). While Bleeding, the enemy will take 24% of their Max HP as Physical DoT at the start of each turn. This DMG will not exceed more than {{dot_dmg}}% of Luka's ATK.

ultimate.name: Coup de Grâce
ultimate.description_template: Receives 2 stack(s) of "Fighting Will," with a 100% base chance to increase one designated enemy target's DMG received by {{vuln}}% for 3 turn(s). Then, deals Physical DMG equal to {{ult_dmg}}% of Luka's ATK to the target.

talent.name: Flying Sparks
talent.description_template: After Luka uses his Basic ATK "Direct Punch" or Skill "Lacerating Fist," he receives 1 stack of Fighting Will, up to 4 stacks. When he has 2 or more stacks of Fighting Will, his Basic ATK "Direct Punch" is enhanced to "Sky-Shatter Fist." After his Enhanced Basic ATK's "Rising Uppercut" hits a Bleeding enemy target, the Bleed status will immediately deal DMG for 1 time equal to {{bleed}}% of the original DMG to the target. At the start of battle, Luka will possess 1 stack of Fighting Will.

technique.name: Anticipator
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Luka deals Physical DMG equal to 50% of his ATK to a random single enemy with a 100% base chance to inflict his Skill's Bleed effect on the target. Then, Luka gains 1 additional stack of Fighting Will. Base Chance

2.name: Kinetic Overload
2.description: When using Skill, immediately dispells 1 buff(s) from the enemy target

4.name: Cycle Braking
4.description: For every stack of Fighting Will obtained, additionally regenerates 3 Energy.

6.name: Crush Fighting Will
6.description: When using Enhanced Basic ATK, every hit of "Direct Punch" has a 50% fixed chance for Luka to use 1 additional hit. This effect does not apply to additional hits generated in this way.

eidolons.name: Fighting Endlessly
eidolons.description: When Luka takes action, if the target enemy is Bleeding, increases DMG dealt by Luka by 15% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: The Enemy is Weak, I am Strong
eidolons.description: If the Skill hits an enemy target with Physical Weakness, gain 1 stack(s) of Fighting Will.

eidolons.name: Born for the Ring
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Never Turning Back
eidolons.description: For every stack of Fighting Will obtained, increases ATK by 5%, stacking up to 4 time(s).

eidolons.name: The Spirit of Wildfire
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: A Champion's Applause
eidolons.description: After the Enhanced Basic ATK's "Rising Uppercut" hits a Bleeding enemy target, the Bleed status will immediately deal DMG 1 time equal to 8% of the original DMG for every hit of Direct Punch already unleashed during the current Enhanced Basic ATK.
